'''Coranth''' was an area of [[Water/Legends|pools]] and grottos in the [[Mining Level/Legends|Mining Level]] of the sinkhole of [[Pau City/Legends|Pau City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]]. The pools' water was [[Color/Legends|blue-green]] in color as they absorbed [[Calcium/Legends|calcium]] minerals through the sinkhole's crustal [[Stone/Legends|rocks]].<ref name="CL" />
